origin: Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-atmosphere-monoliths.mjs: the scene of ATMOSPHERE REFERENCE, in world coordinates on the preset's floor plane (world y -1.2): four cracked rock monoliths (a tall one at the back left, a heavy one at the back right and two shorter ones leaning in from the sides, each a flat-shaded faceted slab with a chiselled crown) around a tall clear crystal at the centre.
